videos.title: Driving a boat: The basics
videos.relevance: This video supports the hands-on boat-handling parts of Requirement 5 by showing throttle control, steering awareness, and basic operator habits in motion. It is a focused, practical demonstration from a credible boating channel rather than a generic merit-badge talk.

videos.title: How to drive a boat in rough water | Big sea throttle techniques explained | Motor Boat & Yachting
videos.relevance: This video fits Requirement 4c because it shows how rough-water conditions change throttle use, hull attitude, and operator decision-making. It teaches weather-and-heavy-water judgment in a way static text cannot fully demonstrate.
